event_description: A new user successfully completed registration via the email/password form.
A user authenticated successfully via the login form.
A user ended their session by logging out.
A returning user signed in via a social OAuth provider (e.g. Google).
A new user created an account for the first time via a social OAuth provider.
A user clicked the verification link and confirmed their email address.
A user submitted the forgot-password form to receive a reset link.
An authenticated user viewed the subscription/plan selection page (top of checkout funnel).
A user initiated a Stripe checkout session to subscribe to a plan.
A user's subscription was created (including demo mode when Stripe is not configured).
An existing subscriber swapped to a different subscription plan.
A user was redirected to the Stripe billing portal to manage their subscription.
A user saved changes to their profile name or email address.
A user permanently deleted their account after confirming with their password.
